Not reviewed: new-requirements.md (draft), design.md (draft), tasks.md (draft). /sdd-spec-review Cart is what promotes a spec to ready. Implementing anyway needs the human to say so in as many words, and the final report then says the work was built from an unreviewed spec.
No build command for the backend stack: .sdd/sdd.conf holds no SDD_BUILD_BACKEND, and pom.xml says this project has that stack. Detection proposes `mvn clean verify` — accept it or name another, and write the line into .sdd/sdd.conf as SDD_BUILD_BACKEND=<command>. A command is one line run from the project root; nothing is built until it is there, because a proposal is not an answer.
